name: Yale University
summary: Yale College in New Haven, Connecticut: over 80 majors chosen by the end of sophomore year; all first-years live in one of 14 residential colleges.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. Predicted IB scores may be submitted but are not required. IB scores do not replace the SAT or ACT, which Yale requires.

programmes.name: Global Affairs
programmes.about: A major at the Jackson School of Global Affairs built on multidisciplinary core courses linking recurring political, economic and social issues across countries and time, taught in small cohorts.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to Yale College, not to a major, and have until the end of sophomore year to choose one. Admission reads the whole file.

flagshipSource.title: Yale Jackson School: the Global Affairs major and its small cohorts

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Yale Engineering's department teaches the strengths and limits of computation and how to invent new computing systems; Yale also lists joint majors with economics, mathematics, psychology and linguistics.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to Yale College, not to a major, and have until the end of sophomore year to choose one. Admission reads the whole file.

flagshipSource.title: Yale Engineering: the Department of Computer Science

notes: Yale says it considers applicants without regard to ability to pay and meets 100% of every family's demonstrated need; international students are eligible for the same need-based aid.
2026-27 tuition is $72,500 and the full cost of attendance (housing, food, fees, books) is $97,985.
Single-Choice Early Action is non-binding, but you may not also apply early to most other private colleges; Regular Decision has no such restriction.
